source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 491 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 491 was established by Ordinance No. 23363, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 10, 1997. Ordinance No. 23363 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 491 is established on property generally located along the north line of Northwest Highway, east of the northeast line of Midway Road. The size of PD 491 is approximately 0.741 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this district, MONUMENT SIGN means a detached sign applied directly onto a grade level support structure (instead of a pole support) with no separation between the sign and grade.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 491A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Church.

(b) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component of Section 51A-4.209(3.1) is not met.] -- Single family.

(c) Transportation uses.

-- Private street or alley.

(d) Utility and public service uses.

-- Local utilities. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.107. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard for each lot is as shown on the development plan.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) For Lot 4, minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) For Lots 1, 2, and 3, minimum side and rear yard for the first story of a structure is as shown on the development plan. Minimum side and rear yard for the second story is 20 feet.

(c) Density. No more than four dwelling units are permitted on the Property.

(d) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(e) Height. Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(f) Stories. Maximum number of stories is two.

(g) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent.

(h) Lot size. Minimum lot area is 8,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Electrical Service For Single Family Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.110. ELECTRICAL SERVICE FOR SINGLE FAMILY USES.

See Section 51A-4.114(8)(B). (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.111. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.112. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must comply with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.113. SIGNS.

(a) With the exception of Subsection (b), signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts contained in Article VII.

(b) One two-sided monument sign, a maximum of 32 square feet in effective area per side, six feet in height, and located within the front yard setback adjacent to Northwest Highway, is permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Barrier free ramps must be installed simultaneously with the paving of the private streets on the Property.

(b) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(c) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-491.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 491 is located on Zoning Map No. F-6. (Ord. Nos. 23363; 26042)
